$comment: Limits on the work the UI does to play these fixtures, held by slow CI's `ui-counts` lane (`just ui-counts --gate`, tools/src/beryl_tools/ui_counts.py). A count that rises more than `tolerance_percent` above its limit fails the lane. Lower the limits whenever a change lowers the counts (`just ui-counts --gate --update`). Raise one only when the change needs the extra work, and say why in the commit's body. The limits are measured on macOS.
